payload.prompt: We have received invoice INV-2026-8735 from the supplier Brightstone Ltd (org no. 913701585) for 8500 NOK including VAT. The amount relates to office services (account 7100). Register the supplier invoice with the correct input VAT (25%).

payload.goal: Register supplier invoice INV-2026-8735 from Brightstone Ltd for 8500 NOK including 25% VAT, posted to account 7100 as office services.
success_checks: Supplier Brightstone Ltd with org no. 913701585 exists or is created.
Supplier invoice INV-2026-8735 is registered for total 8500 NOK.
Input VAT is recorded at 25% with correct net/VAT split.
Supplier invoice is linked to the correct supplier and remains open unless payment is also requested.
risk_notes: Invoice date, due date, and supplier invoice receipt date are not provided and may be required.
Sandbox is empty, so supplier must likely be created first.
Need correct gross-to-net VAT split: 8500 NOK incl. 25% VAT implies net 6800 and VAT 1700.
No attachment provided; some flows may require document reference or file upload.
Assumes NOK is company/base currency or accepted supplier invoice currency.
ordered_steps: Create supplier Brightstone Ltd via supplier endpoint with organization number 913701585.
Verify accounting account 7100 is available and VAT code for 25% input VAT is enabled.
Create/register supplier invoice via supplier invoice endpoint for supplier Brightstone Ltd with invoice number INV-2026-8735, currency NOK, total 8500.
Add invoice line for office services on account 7100 with net amount 6800 and VAT 25%.
Confirm calculated input VAT is 1700 and gross total is 8500.
Save/book the supplier invoice as open payable.

Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting. Tripletex auto-generates VAT and credit postings.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.
